verdict.rationale: Amplitude exposes broad APIs (HTTP V2 event ingestion, Dashboard REST API, Experiment APIs for flags/experiments, Cohorts API, taxonomy CRUD, data export) that mirror many core UI workflows, and an official MCP server lets AI tools query behavioral data. However, several flagship UI capabilities—session replay viewing/analysis, the visual A/B test editor, in-product guides/surveys creation, dashboard/chart creation, and the AI 'ask in plain language' analyst—are documented only as UI features with no corresponding API endpoints in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: API parity for session replay, visual experiment editor, dashboard/notebook creation, and guides/surveys authoring; independent confirmation that API coverage matches UI feature-for-feature.
